parameters.query: WITH old AS (SELECT status AS prev_status FROM pipeline_runs WHERE video_id = $1) UPDATE pipeline_runs SET status = 'retry_pending', failed_step = 'transcript', error_message = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE video_id = $1 RETURNING video_id, (SELECT prev_status FROM old) AS prev_status
